person_only_steps.action: Counsel reviews the software_dispatch_msa template (first). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Counsel reviews the performance_wrapper template (first). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Counsel reviews the assessment_sow template (after the MSA and wrapper). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Counsel reviews the data_sharing_agreement template (after the MSA and wrapper). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Counsel reviews the flexibility_services_agreement template (after the MSA and wrapper). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Counsel reviews the site_access_installation template (after the MSA and wrapper). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Counsel reviews the lender_reliance_letter template (after the MSA and wrapper). Until then it is a draft and is never sent as an offer or presented as reviewed.
Choose and engage counsel for the template review.
Choose and sign an insurer (an MGA or floor provider only after gap G8 closes), and record the FCA PERG 6 perimeter position as counsel's legal opinion.
Agree prices, liability caps, service levels, step-in thresholds and termination periods with each counterparty. The list prices on record are not agreed with anyone.
Sign any contract or reliance letter, and have the counterparty's signed copy registered as an evidence object it issued.
The host's critical-facilities lead signs off each control write path before stage L2 or L3.
Hold a load-control licence or confirm an exemption before closed-loop load control.
Register NEW-IC-15 and WP-GRC-09's release in the Atlas roadmap and ADR index; roadmap and ADR edits are a person's.
